visual_enhancers.metallic_badges: bg-gradient-to-br from-[#D4AF37] to-[#F59E0B] text-black font-bold shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(212,175,55,0.5)]

components.wall_street_ticker: Marquee with JetBrains Mono font, emerald green numbers for positive trends, small gold icons. Slow and elegant.
components.bottom_nav_mobile: Fixed bottom, 5 tabs, glassmorphism background, gold active icon, #9CA3AF inactive.
components.top_nav_desktop: Sticky top, glassmorphism, right-aligned luxury links, gold CTA button for 'Accedi'.
components.property_card: Dark glass card. Blurred off-market image if locked (gold padlock icon). Metallic status badge (ESCLUSIVA). Price with slashed old price.
components.animated_counters: Use Framer Motion to count up (e.g., +14.5M€). JetBrains Mono or Playfair Display with gold accent.
components.buttons: Pill-shaped or sharp-edged. Primary: Gold gradient background with black text. Secondary: Transparent with thin gold border and gold text.
components.interactive_map: Leaflet with CartoDB Dark Matter tiles. Gold custom SVG pins.

grids.bento_marketing: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-6. Hero takes col-span-12, side stats take col-span-4, charts col-span-8.

layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. p-6 or p-8 inside cards. Section gaps py-24.
layouts.alignment: Left-aligned for data and property details. Centered for hero text to emphasize authority.

motion.hover_states: Cards lift slightly (-translate-y-1) and glow increases (border-[#D4AF37]/60).
motion.page_transitions: Fade in and slide up (opacity 0 -> 1, y 20 -> 0).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text on dark backgrounds has at least 4.5:1 ratio. Gold on black is excellent.

image_urls.description: Luxurious illuminated concrete house at evening.
Spacious modern living room featuring elegant chandeliers.
Italian town nestled on a mountain side at sunset.

3d_libraries.recommendation: Framer Motion for layout and micro-interactions. React Leaflet for the dark mode map. React Fast Marquee for the Wall Street ticker. Recharts for the B&B Dashboard charts.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a premium dark-mode application using React and Tailwind CSS.
Strictly adhere to the dark backgrounds (#0A0D14 and #111622) and gold/amber accents.
Implement the Wall Street ticker at the very top using 'react-fast-marquee'.
Use Playfair Display for headings and Manrope for body text.
Construct the 5-tab navigation (Hub, Immobili, Chi Cerca, Servizi, Accedi). Mobile should have a fixed bottom nav; desktop a premium top nav.

In the Home Hub: Include Hero with 'Prenota Private Advisor' modal, 'Chi Cerca Casa Ora' carousel, 'Più Visti' properties, B&B Dashboard Demo (using Recharts), Potenza Neighborhoods ranking, 6 Basilicata Hubs, 6 animated counters, and 'Operazioni Concluse'.
For property cards: Use the specified glassmorphism classes. Include Off-Market blurred states with a gold padlock.

For the Property Detail page: Include RIF code, hype counters, 'In Osservazione Ora' pill, dynamic status labels, slashed price badge, Before/After slider, 'Iper-Potentini' badge, expense thermometer, Pre-Verificato gold shield, Advisor Note box, and a blurred floorplan with padlock.
Implement Leaflet map with CartoDB dark tiles.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
Use Lucide React or Phosphor Icons for iconography. Add thin gold strokes to icons where appropriate.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glassmorphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
Never use AI assistant emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, etc.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Do not apply universal transition 'transition: all'.
